usdRate.note: Secondary source: 5,660.196 pounds per US dollar on 29 October 2026 (down 25% in a year). The Bank of South Sudan home page showed undated buying and selling rates of 5,690.49 and 5,863.81 when read on 3 November 2026; the World Bank 2024 average was 2,163.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: National Bureau of Statistics, Consumer Price Index releases (annual inflation, May 2025)
inflation_cpi.note: 58.21% year on year in May 2025, the latest release the NBS lists (none for 2026; Trading Economics also shows 58.21%). The IMF estimates 97.6% for the 2025 average and projects 27.6% for 2026.

inflation_projection.sourceName: IMF World Economic Outlook, South Sudan inflation (27.6% projected for 2026, 28.3% for 2027, about 5-8% from 2028)
inflation_projection.note: There is no credible inflation target and inflation averaged over 50% a year in 2021-2025, so plans use 20%, below current rates but well above the IMF's hoped-for single digits.

policy_rate.sourceName: Bank of South Sudan central bank rate, via Trading Economics
policy_rate.note: Secondary source: Trading Economics records the central bank rate at 13% for September 2026 (unchanged from the previous reading). The Bank of South Sudan monetary policy page states no rate and says it targets reserve money, so the rate is of limited importance for deposit pricing.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Bank of South Sudan, Statistical Bulletin October 2024, table 1.7 deposit and lending interest rates (savings)
savings_account_rate.note: Average commercial bank savings deposit rate 2.02% at the end of October 2024; older than 2025 and the latest bulletin published.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Bank of South Sudan, Statistical Bulletin October 2024, table 1.7 (deposits 0-3 months)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Average rate on deposits of up to 3 months 0.02% at the end of October 2024; older than 2025, the latest published.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Bank of South Sudan, Statistical Bulletin October 2024, table 1.7 (deposits over 3 months)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Average rate on deposits of over 3 months 0.46% at the end of October 2024 (no separate 1-year rate is published); older than 2025, the latest published.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit scheme or published rate was found in Bank of South Sudan statistics.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST), South Sudan
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 0.08% average for 2025 (IMF International Financial Statistics); the Bank of South Sudan bulletin gave 0.13% for October 2024.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; the Bank of South Sudan treasury bills page shows no products or results.

tbill_91d_rate.note: The Bank of South Sudan treasury bills page (https://boss.gov.ss/treasury-bills/) has only a heading and no auction results, rates or tenors, and no yield was found elsewhere.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year government bond issue or yield was found.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year government bond issue or yield was found.

tax_bank_interest.note: The withholding or income tax rate on bank interest for residents could not be confirmed: PwC Tax Summaries does not cover South Sudan and the National Revenue Authority site shows no tax schedules.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: There is no government savings certificate, and the tax treatment of government securities could not be confirmed.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit insurance scheme or cover limit was found on the Bank of South Sudan site; not confirmed absent.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No credit card interest cap or typical rate was found; the Bank of South Sudan bulletin gives average lending rates only.

equity_return_low.sourceName: IMF World Economic Outlook, South Sudan inflation; Bank of South Sudan deposit rates
equity_return_low.note: Low case: No stock exchange or locally offered retail investment fund was found in South Sudan; a global fund bought abroad in a bad decade with a steadier pound returns little in pound terms.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Bank of South Sudan, Statistical Bulletin October 2024 (term deposits over 3 months 0.46%)
equity_return_base.note: No stock exchange or locally offered retail investment fund was found in South Sudan, so equity means a global index fund in pound terms; the base case is capped at about 4 points above the near-zero term deposit rate, far below what a global index would earn if the pound keeps falling.

equity_return_high.sourceName: IMF World Economic Outlook, South Sudan inflation; Trading Economics USD/SSP
equity_return_high.note: High case: a global index (about 7% a year in dollars) plus continued pound depreciation of 15-20% a year.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Trading Economics USD/SSP (pound down 25% in the year to October 2026)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold and a much slower fall in the pound.

gold_return_base.sourceName: IMF World Economic Outlook, South Sudan inflation; Trading Economics USD/SSP
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% a year plus pound depreciation of about 18% a year, close to the gap between the 20% inflation assumption and dollar inflation.

gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold years and a pound that keeps falling as fast as in the past year (about 25%).

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Bank of South Sudan, Statistical Bulletin October 2024, table 1.7
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: short deposits, which pay almost nothing (0.02% up to 3 months).

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Bank of South Sudan, Statistical Bulletin October 2024, table 1.7
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of savings deposits (2.02%) and term deposits (0.46%), with no tax assumed because none could be confirmed.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Bank of South Sudan, Statistical Bulletin October 2024, table 1.7
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: savings deposits at about 2%.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No insurance regulator statistics on life claim settlement were found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates were found from a regulator or other public source; whether term life is sold locally could not be confirmed.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found from an official or international source.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premium rates were found from a public source.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), South Sudan
oop_health_share.note: 27.1% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database); older than 2025, the latest available. Donors fund much of the rest.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: IMF World Economic Outlook, South Sudan inflation
goal_inflation_health.note: No medical price index was found, and most medicines and equipment are imported and priced off the dollar, so health costs are assumed to rise with the 20% inflation assumption.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: IMF World Economic Outlook, South Sudan inflation
goal_inflation_education.note: No education price index was found; private school fees are often set in dollars, so they are assumed to rise with the 20% inflation assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), South Sudan
life_expectancy.note: 57.7 years in 2024 (men 54.8, women 60.7); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net gives 58.0 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 5.2 (2025, World Bank), 7.8 (2040) and 8.8 (2065, populationpyramid.net/south-sudan/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: No statutory pension age for private-sector workers and no public contributory pension scheme could be confirmed from an official source.

retirement_age_government.note: The civil service retirement age could not be confirmed from an official source (the Civil Service and Pensions Fund Acts could not be loaded).

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Bank of South Sudan, Statistical Bulletin October 2024, table 1.7
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: short deposits paying almost nothing.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Bank of South Sudan, Statistical Bulletin October 2024, table 1.7 (deposits over 3 months 0.46%)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: kept just below the 0.46% average rate on term deposits, the safest pound investment found; real returns are deeply negative.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Bank of South Sudan, Statistical Bulletin October 2024, table 1.7 (savings 2.02%)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: savings deposits at about 2%.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Bank of South Sudan, Statistical Bulletin October 2024

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Bank of South Sudan deposit rates; gold base 22%; equity base 4.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of deposits, a global fund and some gold, which has kept value far better than pound deposits.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: IMF World Economic Outlook, South Sudan inflation; gold high 35%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: a larger share in gold and foreign assets while the pound keeps falling.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age (social) pension paid nationally was found; not confirmed absent.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age (social) pension paid nationally was found; not confirmed absent.

gratuity_rule.note: The end-of-service rules in the Labour Act 2017 could not be read from an official source.

public_pension_scheme.note: No public contributory pension for private-sector workers could be confirmed; civil servants have a separate pension fund whose rules could not be loaded.

savings_account.note: Banks pay about 2% on savings deposits (Bank of South Sudan, October 2024).

dps.note: No monthly recurring deposit scheme was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: The Bank of South Sudan treasury bills page shows no auctions or results; no retail access was found.

tbond_5y.note: No government bond market was found.

tbond_10y.note: No government bond market was found.

equity_fund.note: No stock exchange or locally offered retail investment fund was found in South Sudan.

gold.note: Gold is mined artisanally and sold locally, mostly as jewellery and raw gold; no official bullion product was found.
